name: Giving and gift card writes
description: Run giving campaigns (create, edit, activate, complete, delete), start and cancel donors' monthly gifts (Stripe subscriptions), delete an offline donation or record a refund paid outside Stripe, import gift cards sold elsewhere (Gift Up! and others), and apply gift cards to organizer reservations. Amounts ending in `_cents` are integers in the currency's minor unit. Campaign, donation, monthly-gift and import routes need `commerce:write` (`commerce:read` to list monthly gifts); gift cards on reservations need `tickets:write`, like the reservations themselves. These writes need an organization API key.

endpoints.description: Opens a Stripe Checkout page for a donor's monthly gift to an active campaign; send the donor to checkout_url. endpoints.description: Records money given back outside Stripe (cash, a check, a bank transfer). Exos never calls Stripe here. Each refund is a ledger row; the same reference (or Idempotency-Key) again changes nothing and answers 200; never more than is left. Once nothing is left the donation reads refunded. Also answers at /v1/donations/{id}/offline_refund.

parameters.description: How much was given back (default: all that is left).

endpoints.description: Brings in gift cards sold elsewhere (Gift Up! and other providers): up to 500 a request. Each keeps its own code (6-64 letters and digits; dashes and spaces are ignored) and pays at checkout and on reservations like any Exos card. A code already imported from the same source is a duplicate and is left alone; a resend with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first result (200). Imported cards never paid the Exos fee when they were sold, so spending one owes it on its part, like a box-office card. Only a hash of each code is stored. Also answers at /v1/gift-cards/bulk and /v1/gift_up_giftcards/bulk.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Where the cards come from, 2-40 of a-z, 0-9 and _ (default gift_up).

parameters.name: cards
parameters.description: The cards (also accepted as gift_cards or giftcards). Each: code; balance_cents (or balance / remaining_value in major units); optional initial_cents (or initial_value), currency (default usd), expires_at (or expiry_date), recipient_email, recipient_name.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a resend of the same batch answer the first result; the same key with other cards answers 400.

endpoints.summary: Apply a gift card to a reservation
endpoints.description: Takes up to amount_cents (default: all that is due) off a gift card for an active organizer reservation; the balance moves at once. Completing the reservation spends it; cancelling or letting it expire gives it back. Two reservations can't overdraw one card: each takes at most what is left. Several cards may go on one reservation, each once. Card problems (wrong code, no balance, another currency) answer 422 and count against a limit of 10 tries a minute. An Idempotency-Key makes a resend the same redemption. Also answers at Opendate's /v1/confirms/{id}/organizer_ticket_reservations/{token}/gift_card_redemptions.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The gift card code (an Exos code or an imported one; also gift_card_code).

parameters.name: amount_cents
parameters.description: At most this much (default: what is due).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a resend the same redemption.
